notes: Free plan: max 1 rate-limit rule. Throttles Turnstile verify abuse (OTP/signup/login bot burst). Contact form POSTs go to Convex directly, so Convex rate_limits remain the second layer. SCOPE LIMIT: this ruleset is zone-scoped, so it throttles only turfzo.app and www.turfzo.app. wrangler.jsonc and wrangler.staging.jsonc both set workers_dev:true and preview_urls:true, so the same worker also answers on turfzo-web.turfzobusiness.workers.dev, turfzo-web-staging.turfzobusiness.workers.dev and per-deploy preview URLs. Those are served by workers.dev, where Cloudflare does not permit WAF rules, so an attacker can replay this endpoint against the workers.dev origin unthrottled. The path list carries the trailing-slash form because http.request.uri.path is the raw request line and /api/turnstile/verify/ resolves to the same Next.js route handler. Closing the workers.dev gap needs an in-worker limiter or dropping workers_dev/preview_urls from the wrangler configs — see the note in waf-custom-rules.json.
